description: This file defines the Map.Drag handler for the Leaflet mapping library, enabling map dragging with inertia and related options.

classes.name: Drag
classes.description: A handler class extending Handler to enable map dragging with inertia and boundary constraints.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Initializes dragging, sets up event listeners, and enables dragging.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Removes dragging event listeners and disables dragging.

methods.name: moved
methods.description: Returns whether the map has moved during dragging.

methods.name: moving
methods.description: Returns whether the map is currently being moved.

methods.name: _onDragStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a drag, stops map, sets boundary limits, and fires events.

methods.name: _onDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging motion, records positions for inertia.

methods.name: _prunePositions
methods.description: Removes old position records outside a time window for inertia calculation.

methods.name: _onZoomEnd
methods.description: Updates world offset and width after zooming.

methods.name: _viscousLimit
methods.description: Applies a viscous limit to dragging outside bounds.

methods.name: _onPreDragLimit
methods.description: Limits dragging within bounds with viscous effect.

methods.name: _onPreDragWrap
methods.description: Handles map wrapping when dragging across world boundaries.

methods.name: _onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of dragging, calculates inertia, and initiates inertial movement if applicable.
